tee.seo_p1: The Tee is the classic branch fitting for symmetrical flow division in PP-R networks.
tee.seo_p2: Made of robust polypropylene (PP-R), it offers three equally dimensioned socket ends that fully support the nominal pressure of the piping system.
tee.seo_p3: It is the heart of every ring and series line in sanitary installations and ensures reliable, low-pressure-loss distribution of the medium.

faq.q: Does the tee reduce the pipe cross-section?
faq.a: No, the interior design of our tees is designed for full bore so as not to throttle the volume flow.

faq.q: Is a tee more susceptible to deposits?
faq.a: Thanks to the extremely smooth PP-R material (roughness value 0.007 mm), limescale and biofilms have no chance of settling even in the branches.

faq.q: Are different welding times required for large tees?
faq.a: Yes, the heating, changeover, and cooling times depend on the dimension and must be strictly observed according to DVS guidelines.

cross.seo_p1: The Cross allows a main flow to be distributed in three different directions within a compact installation level.
cross.seo_p2: This four-way PP-R fitting is flow-optimised to minimize turbulence and seamlessly integrates into our high-pressure SDR series.
cross.seo_p3: Perfect for complex distribution cabinets and central crossing points in building services, it replaces multiple tees and thus saves valuable installation space and time.

faq.q: Does the cross cause high pressure losses?
faq.a: Since four flows can meet, the Zeta value is higher than with straight pipes, but the generous interior design keeps the loss minimal.

faq.q: In which situations is a cross mandatory?
faq.a: Especially in pre-wall installations or underfloor heating manifolds, where construction must be extremely flat and symmetrical.

faq.q: Are the branches always the same size?
faq.a: In our standard cross, all four connections have the same dimensions (e.g., 4x 20mm).

cross-over.seo_p1: The Cross-over is a clever solution for crossing cold and hot water lines in confined spaces.
cross-over.seo_p2: The curved PP-R fitting features integrated socket ends and an elegant bridge shape that allows pipe routing on one level without height offset.
cross-over.seo_p3: It prevents collisions in wall installations and underfloor heating and guarantees smooth flow with a visually perfect, flat pipe layout.

faq.q: How big is the curve of the gooseneck?
faq.a: The bend is precisely dimensioned so that a crossing K Aqua pipe of the same or smaller dimension is bridged without contact.

faq.q: Are special sockets needed for installation?
faq.a: The gooseneck (cross-over) typically has unwelded pipe ends and is integrated into the system on both sides with standard sockets.

faq.q: Can I shape a straight PP-R pipe into a cross-over myself using heat?
faq.a: No! Manual bending with hot air guns destroys the molecular structure of the pipe and immediately voids the warranty.

cross-over-pipe.seo_p1: The Cross-over Pipe is the extended version of the cross-over, ideal for pipe bridges without direct socket connection at the ends.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p2: Manufactured from high-quality PP-R, this bridge component offers pure insertion ends that allow maximum flexibility when positioning the welding sockets.
cross-over-pipe.seo_p3: Installers use this component for difficult crossings in large distribution systems to flexibly adapt the routing to the conditions on site.

faq.q: What is the difference between the crossing tee and the cross?
faq.a: The crossing tee allows crossing a line without contact and integrates a branch at the same time.

faq.q: How is this component welded?
faq.a: It is integrated into the pipeline network analogous to standard fittings by means of heating element socket welding.

faq.q: Is the flow hindered by the construction?
faq.a: Despite the compact geometry, the interior is flow-optimised so that no significant cross-sectional narrowing occurs.

adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p1: The Adaptor Socket Female Thread forms an essential interface between the welded PP-R piping system and metallic threaded components.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p2: It combines a robust PP-R socket body with a high-quality metal insert (female thread). This ensures excellent pressure resistance at standard SDR levels.
adaptor-socket-female-thread.seo_p3: This fitting is indispensable when connecting valves, pressure gauges, and special fittings in building installations to guarantee permanently drip-free transitions.

faq.q: What is the mounting plate for?
faq.a: The integrated plate with holes enables the rigid, mechanical fixation of the elbow directly to the wall or a mounting element.

faq.q: Is the metal thread susceptible to corrosion?
faq.a: No, the metallic inserts are made of high-quality, dezincification-resistant brass and are therefore highly corrosion-resistant.

faq.q: Can I seal the thread with hemp?
faq.a: We recommend using Teflon tape (PTFE tape). If using hemp, it should only be used very sparingly and with non-swelling paste to avoid bursting the brass insert.

adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p1: The Adaptor Socket Male Thread allows the firm and secure connection of the PP-R network to subsequent metallic pipelines.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p2: A pull-out-proof anchoring of the brass male thread in the high-strength polypropylene body prevents twisting and guarantees extreme longevity at high temperature and pressure fluctuations.
adaptor-socket-male-thread.seo_p3: Frequently used when connecting boilers, heat pumps, or filters, this socket ensures a permanent and standard-compliant threaded connection.

faq.q: Is the female thread entirely made of brass?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread is a solid, high-quality brass insert securely and twist-proof molded into the PP-R material.

faq.q: Can the connection be loosened if necessary?
faq.a: Yes, the metallic thread allows the safe disassembly of connected equipment such as pumps or filters at any time.

faq.q: What is the maximum tightening torque?
faq.a: The thread should be tightened with standard tools and care to avoid stress cracks in the adjacent plastic.

elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The Elbow 90° Male Thread combines a right-angled change of direction with a direct threaded connection to metal components.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p2: This dimensionally stable PP-R component is equipped with a solid male thread insert that absorbs thermal expansion and meets the high demands of SDR pressure classes.
elbow-90-male-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for tight installation situations on machines or manifolds where a direct 90-degree connection must be made without further fitting combinations.

faq.q: Does this fitting combine two work steps?
faq.a: Yes, it combines a change of direction by 90 degrees with a threaded transition, which saves space, material, and a weld seam.

faq.q: Is the male thread roughened?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua male threads are often slightly roughened at the factory so that the sealing tape (Teflon) does not slip off when screwed in.

faq.q: What material is the male thread made of?
faq.a: It consists of dezincification-resistant special brass, which is approved for the highest hygiene requirements in the drinking water sector.

elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Elbow Bracket 90° Female Thread is the standard component for a stable and secure wall mounting of outlet valves.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: Thanks to the integrated mounting lugs on the PP-R body and the robust metal female thread, it safely transfers all leverage forces into the masonry.
elbow-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: It is used across the board in the installation of showers, bathtubs, or sinks to mount faucets exactly and twist-proof.

faq.q: Can the wall bracket also be used in drywall?
faq.a: Yes, in combination with our special K Aqua mounting plates, it can be perfectly fixed in plasterboard or wooden stud walls.

faq.q: Is there sound insulation for this component?
faq.a: For optimal sound insulation, we offer optional rubber sound insulation caps that decouple the wall bracket from the building structure.

faq.q: What material is the female thread made of?
faq.a: We exclusively use lead-free or dezincification-resistant (DZR) special brass, compliant with the strictest drinking water regulations.

elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Extended Elbow Wall Bracket 90° Female Thread offers additional flexibility for deeper concealed installations due to its greater distance.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p2: With an extended PP-R neck and a high-strength brass female thread, this component is designed for installations that have to bridge thick plaster or tile thicknesses.
elbowwall-bracket-90-female-thread.seo_p3: Sanitary installers use this element when fitting connections are deeply recessed in drywall to maintain full pressure stability.

faq.q: When is a wall bracket with a male thread used instead of a female thread?
faq.a: It is typically required when flexible reinforced hoses (e.g., from washbasin fittings) are to be connected directly with a union nut.

faq.q: Is the mounting plate stable enough under strong tension?
faq.a: Yes, thanks to the three integrated screw eyelets, the leverage is dissipated over a large area, making the wall mounting extremely stable.

faq.q: Can extensions be screwed on?
faq.a: If the wall bracket sits too deep in the wall, standard brass tap extensions can easily be screwed on.

metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The Metal Union Male Thread Yellow Brass enables detachable connections between PP-R and metal at the highest quality level.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: The uncoated quality brass is firmly connected to the weldable PP-R socket. An integrated sealing ring guarantees safety in all common SDR pressure classes.
metal-union-male-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: Used primarily in drinking water installations for connecting water meters or pumps that need to be dismantled quickly for maintenance purposes.

faq.q: Is this tee suitable for connecting drain valves?
faq.a: Yes, the female thread in the branch is the standard solution for directly screwing in drain or KFE valves at the lowest point.

faq.q: Is the brass insert firmly anchored?
faq.a: Through a special knurling on the brass insert, it is permanently enclosed by the PP-R, which prevents twisting when threading.

faq.q: Does the thread reduce the flow in the main line?
faq.a: No, the main line of the tee (the passage) has a full cross-section and is flow-optimised.

metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p1: The Metal Union Female Thread Yellow Brass is the ideal solution for highly resilient, separable pipe connections.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p2: Equipped with a high-quality brass union nut and a PP-R welding end, this union offers an absolutely tension-free and tight connection.
metal-union-female-thread-yellow-brass.seo_p3: It is frequently used to integrate maintenance elements, filters, or valves in the pipeline network that are regularly cleaned or replaced.

faq.q: Where is the tee with male thread typically used?
faq.a: It is ideal for directly branching off equipment with a female thread or union nuts (e.g., strainers or small circulation pumps).

faq.q: Is there a risk of cracking in the plastic with male threads?
faq.a: No, because with male threads the expansion force of the sealant (Teflon) acts on the solid brass body and not on the plastic.

faq.q: Can I use it in hot water systems?
faq.a: Of course. Like all K Aqua transition fittings, it is approved for continuous temperatures up to 70°C and short-term peaks of 95°C.

metal-union-male-thread.seo_p1: The nickel-plated Metal Union Male Thread combines an elegant appearance with outstanding technical detachability between plastic and metal systems.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p2: The nickel-plated threaded insert effectively protects against external influences and corrosion, while the PP-R body has the usual pressure and temperature resistance for SDR pipes.
metal-union-male-thread.seo_p3: Particularly preferred in visible pre-wall installations or heating construction, it guarantees clean transitions to metallic radiators or manifolds.

faq.q: What is the advantage of a union compared to a transition socket?
faq.a: The union is separable. This means that the connected component can later be easily dismantled without cutting the PP-R pipe.

faq.q: Is the seal included in the union?
faq.a: Yes, K Aqua unions are supplied as standard with a high-quality EPDM flat gasket (for water).

faq.q: May the union nut be tightened with heavy tools?
faq.a: It should be tightened hand-tight plus a quarter turn with a suitable open-end wrench so as not to crush the seal.

metal-union-female-thread.seo_p1: The nickel-plated Metal Union Female Thread is the premium connecting element for visually demanding and detachable system transitions.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p2: The combination of a nickel-plated brass union nut and robust polypropylene (PP-R) creates a dimensionally stable, permanently sealed connection for high network pressure levels.
metal-union-female-thread.seo_p3: This fitting is the preferred choice when connecting heat exchangers or pump groups in the heating cellar where corrosion protection is important.

faq.q: Where is this male thread union required?
faq.a: Often as a device connection fitting for water meters or heat exchangers that have a female thread on the housing.

faq.q: Does the PP-R remain tension-free when tightened?
faq.a: Yes, the loose union nut absorbs the torsional forces during tightening, so that no torsional stress is transferred into the welded pipe network.

faq.q: Is the brass material certified for drinking water?
faq.a: We exclusively use high-purity DZR brass, which meets all standards of the European Drinking Water Directive (UBA list).

tee-90-male-thread.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Male Thread enables a seamless transition from a continuous PP-R line to a metallic branch.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p2: The T-body made of PP-R ensures undisturbed longitudinal flow, while the branching metal insert (male thread) defies the highest shear forces and system pressures.
tee-90-male-thread.seo_p3: Ideal for the direct installation of sensors, drain valves, or pressure gauges in the middle of the pipe run without mechanically weakening the main network.

faq.q: What are the advantages of the welding saddle over a tee?
faq.a: It allows subsequent branches without cutting the main line and minimizes the impact on system integrity.

faq.q: How is the saddle mounted?
faq.a: The main pipe is tapped with a special drill, then the pipe and saddle are simultaneously heated and precisely fused.

faq.q: Is it suitable for sprinkler systems?
faq.a: The K Aqua saddle branch is successfully used in some international markets for connecting sprinkler heads in lightweight construction.

tee-90-female-thread.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Female Thread is a versatile component to integrate a valve or a sensor directly into a continuous PP-R line.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p2: With two welding sockets for the flow and a solid female thread branch, this component meets all stability requirements within the SDR pressure classes.
tee-90-female-thread.seo_p3: Often used for connecting sampling valves in drinking water distributions or as an interface for thermometers in heating systems.

faq.q: Does the saddle with male thread offer the same strength?
faq.a: Absolutely. The brass insert is deeply anchored in the PP-R matrix, ensuring the component remains fully pressure resistant (PN 25).

faq.q: Are there limitations on the branch size?
faq.a: For technical reasons, the diameter of the saddle branch must always be significantly smaller than the diameter of the main line (e.g., 63 mm to 1/2").

faq.q: Can the saddle also be welded to fiber pipes?
faq.a: Yes, it is equally suitable for all K Aqua pipe types (standard, PPRCT, fiber, UV) after local tapping.

union.seo_p1: The all-plastic Union is a connecting element made entirely of polypropylene (PP-R) that creates a detachable connection without metallic components.
union.seo_p2: With a reliable sealing system and robust plastic union nuts, this union fully withstands the standard operating pressure of the PP-R piping system.
union.seo_p3: It is indispensable for completely corrosion-free systems, such as in the chemical industry or with aggressive media where metal contact must be strictly avoided.

faq.q: When do I choose a PP-R flange instead of a metallic backing flange?
faq.a: A PP-R flange is used when the pumped medium is highly corrosive and any contact with metal must be avoided (all-plastic system).

faq.q: Are there pressure restrictions for all-plastic flanges?
faq.a: Since plastic is more flexible than steel, the maximum nominal pressures for plastic flanges are slightly reduced in the larger dimensions.

faq.q: Are special washers required for the screws?
faq.a: Yes, it is strongly recommended to use large-area washers to distribute the clamping force of the screw evenly on the plastic.

union-for-watermeters.seo_p1: The Union for Watermeters was specifically developed for the tension-free and standard-compliant integration of water meters into PP-R pipelines.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p2: The design includes a weldable PP-R end and a sealing option on the solid union nut, designed for the standard network pressures of drinking water systems.
union-for-watermeters.seo_p3: It allows a quick and safe change of the counting units without tool wear and prevents leaks through a precisely fitting flat gasket.

faq.q: What distinguishes a water meter union?
faq.a: It typically has a sealing option and special thread dimensions that are exactly matched to standard water meters.

faq.q: Are the seals designed for hot water?
faq.a: Depending on the version, the included special seals are specified for cold water meters or also for hot water (heat meters).

faq.q: Can the PP-R pipe bear the weight of the water meter?
faq.a: For larger and heavier meters (house connection), we recommend a separate support for the meter so as not to mechanically stress the pipe network.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p1: The PP-R Ball Valve Ball in PP is a completely corrosion-free shut-off valve for the highest hygiene requirements.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p2: This all-plastic valve has a durable PP-R body and a precisely manufactured ball made of polypropylene. It reliably withstands the system pressures of the SDR classes.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-pp.seo_p3: It is frequently used in chemical industrial plants or with demineralized water because it systematically eliminates any metal contact with the pumped medium.

faq.q: What is the advantage of a plastic ball in the valve?
faq.a: It prevents corrosion and ion release into the medium, which is absolutely necessary for ultrapure water or aggressive chemicals.

faq.q: Is the valve also suitable for hot water?
faq.a: Yes, the special thermoplastic of the ball and the Teflon seals (PTFE) guarantee full function even at high temperatures.

faq.q: How is the valve maintained?
faq.a: Thanks to their design, K Aqua PP-R ball valves are absolutely maintenance-free and designed for decades of trouble-free operation.

pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p1: The PP-R Ball Valve Ball in Brass Chromium Plated combines the weldability of plastic with the mechanical hardness of metal.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p2: Embedded in a solid PP-R body, the high-gloss chrome-plated brass ball ensures extremely low-friction and wear-free shut-off even at high temperature differences.
pp-r-ball-valve-ball-in-brass-chromium-p.seo_p3: This is the standard valve for the main shut-off in drinking water and heating networks, characterized by absolute reliability and a long, maintenance-free service life.

faq.q: Does the brass ball offer flow advantages?
faq.a: Yes, the chrome-plated brass ball can be manufactured with thinner walls, allowing a full, resistance-free passage.

faq.q: Is the brass ball suitable for drinking water?
faq.a: Of course, we exclusively use high-purity, certified DZR brass, which does not release heavy metals into the drinking water.

faq.q: Can the valve be integrated into existing metal pipe networks?
faq.a: Yes, in combination with transition sockets or flanges, it can easily be used as a shut-off valve in mixed installations.

tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p1: The Tee 90° Female Thread for Internal Valve forms the basis for an invisible and space-saving valve installation in the wall.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p2: It consists of a PP-R flow body with a specially deep-drawn brass female thread in the branch that allows the accommodation of valve head parts.
tee-90-female-thread-for-internal-valve.seo_p3: Sanitary professionals use this component in pre-wall installations for showers and bathtubs to integrate shut-off valves aesthetically and safely behind tiles.

faq.q: What is the function of the concealed valve?
faq.a: It allows line shut-off of individual wet rooms (e.g., bathroom or kitchen) directly on site without having to go to the basement.

faq.q: How deep can the valve sit in the wall?
faq.a: The installation depth is variable. If the valve sits too deep due to thick tile construction, we offer corresponding spindle extensions.

faq.q: Is the spindle replaceable?
faq.a: Yes, the entire mechanical internal head part (spindle, seal) can be unscrewed and replaced if necessary without opening the wall.

concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p1: The Concealed Valve Chrome Light Part offers an elegant visible component for wall-integrated shut-offs.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p2: The set includes a handle and a rosette made of chrome-plated ABS plastic, suitable for the standardized brass spindles of our concealed valve bodies.
concealed-valve-chrome-light-part.seo_p3: It serves for the comfortable and visually appealing water shut-off directly in the wet room, ideal for modern and cost-sensitive property constructions.

faq.q: Is the chrome handle included in the delivery?
faq.a: Yes, this set includes the PP-R valve base as well as the complete, high-gloss chrome-plated visible set including rosette.

faq.q: Can the rosette be mounted after tiling?
faq.a: Of course. The base body is welded under plaster, the rosette and handle are only attached after the wall has been completed.

faq.q: What material is the handle made of?
faq.a: The rotary handle consists of a robust zinc die-cast alloy (Zamak) with a durable, easy-care chrome coating.

concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p1: The heavy concealed valve upper part made of chrome-plated brass (Concealed Valve Chrome Heavy Part) is the premium choice for exclusive bathroom fittings.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p2: The rosette and operating handle are made of solid, high-gloss chrome-plated brass, which ensures maximum mechanical resilience and an elegant feel.
concealed-valve-chrome-heavy-part.seo_p3: This version withstands intensive use in hotels or public sanitary facilities and retains its flawless shine for decades.

faq.q: What distinguishes the 'Long' model from the standard concealed valve?
faq.a: The extended spindle design effortlessly bridges deep wall structures, such as thick marble slabs or double-layer drywall.

faq.q: Does the handle have a colour marking?
faq.a: Yes, interchangeable colour markings (red/blue) are included with our sets for easy distinction between hot and cold water lines.

faq.q: How is the valve seat sealed?
faq.a: We use highly heat-resistant EPDM profile seals in the inner upper part, which are extremely resistant to chemical cleaners and thermal disinfection.

straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p1: The straight seat valve upper part with green handle (Straight Seat Valve Upper Part Green Handle) is the proven mechanism for precise flow regulation.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p2: Equipped with a high-quality brass spindle, a durable EPDM seal, and the distinctive green handwheel, it is designed for high system pressures and temperatures.
straight-seat-valve-upper-part-green-han.seo_p3: Screwed into the corresponding PP-R valve lower parts, it is used for safe branch shut-off in heating cellars and main distributions of building services.

faq.q: Is this component a spare part?
faq.a: Yes, it is the complete internal mechanical working (upper part) of the concealed valve, ideal for maintenance purposes or modular assembly.

faq.q: Does the entire valve need to be replaced if it drips?
faq.a: No, it is sufficient to turn off the water and replace this brass upper part; the PP-R base body remains in the wall.

faq.q: How often does the upper part need to be greased?
faq.a: The spindle thread is provided with a food-safe permanent lubrication ex works; subsequent maintenance is not required.

elongation-pieces.seo_p1: The elongation pieces are indispensable problem solvers when fitting connections are hidden too deep in the masonry.
elongation-pieces.seo_p2: These solid brass components extend the thread of concealed valves outwards with millimeter precision, without reducing the flow cross-section or compromising pressure resistance.
elongation-pieces.seo_p3: They save installations in the event of subsequently increased wall structures or thick tile coverings and ensure the problem-free assembly of the visible operating elements.

faq.q: When do I need a valve extension?
faq.a: If the plaster or tiles turn out thicker than planned and the spindle of the concealed valve no longer protrudes far enough from the wall.

faq.q: Can multiple extensions be combined?
faq.a: Technically this is possible, but for reasons of stability we recommend using a long upper part ('Long') immediately instead.

faq.q: Is the extension thread standardized?
faq.a: Yes, the threads of our extensions fit exactly onto the standard upper parts of the K Aqua concealed valves.
